Container.Name: mtphotos
Container.Overview:
MT Photos 是面向 NAS 用户的私有照片与视频管理系统，支持导入已有图库、手机备份、缩略图、预览、人脸识别和地理位置元数据。本模板使用 mtphotos/mt-photos:latest，内置 PostgreSQL 数据库。
English: MT Photos is a private photo and video management system for NAS users. It supports importing existing libraries, mobile photo backup, thumbnails, previews, face recognition and location metadata. This template uses mtphotos/mt-photos:latest with bundled PostgreSQL.
Container.Description: MT Photos with its bundled PostgreSQL database. Persist and back up /config because it contains the database, application settings, thumbnails, previews and cache.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: photo photos gallery album backup NAS PostgreSQL database
Container.Requires: 需要 x86_64 系统。建议系统内存至少 4 GB、双核 2.0 GHz CPU。 English: Requires x86_64. Recommended: at least 4 GB RAM and a dual-core 2.0 GHz CPU.

Config.Name: 网页端口 / WebUI Port
Config.Description: MT Photos 网页访问端口，可按需修改宿主机端口。 English: MT Photos web interface port; change the host port if needed.

Config.Name: 配置与数据库目录 / Config and Database
Config.Description: 保存内置 PostgreSQL 数据库、应用配置、缩略图、预览及缓存。此目录必须持久化并备份。 English: Stores the bundled PostgreSQL database, application settings, thumbnails, previews and cache. This directory must be persisted and backed up.

Config.Name: 上传目录 / Upload
Config.Description: 保存通过 MT Photos 手机 App 备份的照片和视频，需要可写权限。 English: Writable destination for photos and videos backed up from the MT Photos mobile app.

Config.Name: 图库目录 / Photos
Config.Description: 已有照片和视频所在目录，请将宿主机路径改为实际图库路径。如不允许修改原文件，请改为只读模式。 English: Existing photo and video library. Set the host path to your library; use read-only mode to prevent changes to originals.

Config.Name: 临时目录（可选） / temp (optional)
Config.Description: 可选的临时文件目录映射，需要可写权限及足够空间。尚未确认 MT Photos 会自动将临时转码文件写入 /temp；仅添加映射不代表转码路径已设置。 English: Optional writable temporary storage with sufficient free space. Automatic use of /temp for transcoding has not been verified; this mapping alone does not configure the transcoding path.

Config.Name: 时区 / Timezone
Config.Description: 容器时区，使用 IANA 格式，例如 Asia/Shanghai 或 Europe/London。 English: Container timezone in IANA format, for example Asia/Shanghai or Europe/London.
